references.text: Previously the Israelites fled before the men of Ai, but now the situation turns as part of Joshua's strategy
Joshua instructs the people to pretend they are fleeing, which is the same tactic carried out here
Similar military tactics where the Israelites feign flight to lure the enemy into an ambush
The tribe of Israel uses the same flight strategy against Benjamin as Joshua used against Ai
Flight toward the wilderness as part of battle, a recurring theme in Israelite war history
The men of Ai realize they have been tricked when they see the smoke from the city after pursuing the fleeing Israelites
